evidence.decision: Distinguishes suggested values from a closed permitted set and keeps custom entry separate from suggestion-list mutation.
evidence.artifact: Requires field/list/value implementation or concrete suggestion/validation contract with initial value, label and commit rules.
evidence.transformation: Paper-width example permits valid custom widths while preserving the curated list, using a separate save-preset action if needed.
evidence.verification: Checks listed/custom/invalid input, focus departure and localized length; fails custom rejection or silent global suggestion mutation.
evidence.applicability: Explicit Mac-only scope, title-case category label with colon and normal native-input evidence limits match the guide.
evidence.handoffs: Routes closed choices to pop-up-buttons and ordinary free entry to text-fields based on the actual value domain.
evidence.distinctiveness: A value absent from suggestions is not automatically invalid; that consequential distinction shapes the entry and storage contract.
